name: redeemid-emdash-starter
description: An EmDash site on Cloudflare with Shopify commerce: a shop, a cart, Shopify checkout, store sign-in and members-only content.

REDEEMID_SHOPIFY_STORE_DOMAIN.description: Your store's myshopify.com domain, such as my-store.myshopify.com.

REDEEMID_SHOPIFY_CUSTOMER_ACCOUNT_CLIENT.description: Shopify admin → Sales channels → Headless → your storefront → Customer Account API → Client ID. Readers sign in with it.

REDEEMID_SHOPIFY_STOREFRONT_PRIVATE_TOKE.description: Shopify admin → Sales channels → Headless → your storefront → Storefront API → Private access token. The shop, cart and checkout use it.

REDEEMID_SHOPIFY_ADMIN_APP_CLIENT_SECRET.description: The client secret of a Shopify app installed on the store (Dev Dashboard). It checks the signature on Shopify's webhooks.
